Maya: I'm watching! 8pm kickoff, rumor of heavy rotation on the home side.
Jon: unhelpful hot take: always bench the keeper in rainy games.
Priyanka: lol @Jon that's superstition. also reminder: coffee run at halftime? 
CoffeeBot: Coffee run scheduled at 8:45pm. Reply with your order: americano, latte, espresso.
Alex: I'll take a latte. If my goalie tanks, latte is compensation.
Maya: americano for me. also small side bet: loser brings next week's pastries.
Jon: confirmed. I'll bring pastries if my bench score is lowest.
Priyanka: agreed. GIF: https://giphy.com/soccer-cheer.gif
